about.label: About
about.heroHeading: Enterprise-grade AI for your job search
about.heroDesc: Open Ai Jobs Search is a premium AI platform that turns your profile into tailored CVs, ranks every offer by fit, and prepares you for interviews — with automatic failover across five+ AI providers.
about.problemP1: Applying for jobs shouldn't be a second job. But between tailoring a CV for every opening, writing cover letters, tracking applications, and preparing for interviews, it's easy to burn out before you land anything.
about.problemP2: Generic templates waste your time, and most AI tools depend on a single provider — one rate limit or outage and your search stops. Free tools? They often train on your data.
about.solutionP1: Open Ai Jobs Search builds everything from your profile: an ATS-ready base CV, offers ranked by fit, tailored documents per application, and interview prep. Deterministic scoring decides where you fit — AI handles the writing.
about.solutionP2: Under the hood, a resilient orchestrator falls back across five+ AI providers — Anthropic, OpenAI, NVIDIA, LM Studio and Ollama — so a rate limit never stops you. Your data stays encrypted and is never used for training. Pay only with credits when you need more.
about.ctaHeading: Ready to transform your job search?
about.ctaDesc: Start with a free account and some credits. No card required — upgrade to Max whenever you need more.
